evidence.observation: Baseline after purge was about 4-8 ppm through the ramp.
Rising steadily through growth: 13.5, 23.9, 30.9, 38.3, 47.4 and 54.5 ppm at t=3120 s, a roughly linear climb that points to air getting in.
Argon flow is steady at its 100 sccm setpoint, so falling purge flow does not explain the rise.
Thermocouple holds 750 °C with heater power steady around 44%, so temperature control looks normal.
No pressure gauge is installed, so the tube atmosphere cannot be fully checked and pressure cannot confirm a leak or rule out an exhaust blockage.
